environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with no caching layer. DynamoDB table 'users-table' uses on-demand capacity. IAM role attached to the task has dynamodb:GetItem permission with no condition keys. Server-Timing header is exposed to clients. No rate limiting configured on ALB or application level. Network latency between ECS task and DynamoDB endpoint is minimal (<1ms jitter) due to VPC endpoint with dedicated ENI.
